scope: No-model cross-owner audit after RTL3.7-A/B/C. It records current bounded witness closure and remaining functional-source replacement gaps; it changes no hardware behavior or architecture contract.

reviewed_current_closures.rtl3_7a: shared R3-durable eight-fragment payload continuity into the testbench C2 R1 path
reviewed_current_closures.rtl3_7b: endpoint terminal to final association release to matching R6 retirement ordering
reviewed_current_closures.rtl3_7c: C2/publication R1-R2 drain-fact join before the unchanged R6 collector plus bounded fault/stall/reset event evidence

review_findings.r03_1_c2_grant_owner: open: C2 demand/publication/descriptor/lease are test-harness facts, not a functional producer
review_findings.r03_2_sidecar_source: open: S2 sidecar remains a named static fixture transport
review_findings.r03_3_dynamic_partial_path: open: top-level source packet offers/value fragments are tied inactive; source owners are not bound through the functional partial provider
review_findings.r03_4_dynamic_r4_path: open: top-level R4 result/numeric fault are tied inactive; same-instance result is static fixture replay
review_findings.r03_5_verification_ingress: open: production top retains explicit verification ingress and inert read/maintenance carriers
review_findings.r03_6_provenance_replay: open provenance hygiene: RTL3.7-A/B immutable historical manifests do not validate against the newer shared source snapshot
review_findings.r03_7_dynamic_coverage: open: current same-instance functional witness is packed-only and does not cover all source subsets or a dynamic full-path fault

rtl3_functional_closure_criteria: one same-instance retained transaction reaches hot->pending->packed->packed read->S2->source service->partial producer->R4->R6 terminal->retire->durable reclaim->retire_ack without interior testbench injection
each cross-owner fact has exactly one named producer and frozen consumer while R3 publication remains the only pending-to-packed authority handoff
frontend query/position and R1 functional memory are explicit non-authoritative environments rather than substitutes for scheduling, metadata authority, or terminal ownership
hot/direct-pending/S2 provide payload-sideband only; the unique partial provider emits dynamic frozen-order partials; R4 returns one matching success XOR fault to R6
directed dynamic tests cover all nonempty legal source subsets, four GQA completions, backpressure, stale/mismatch, reset, and fault outcomes
a current aggregate manifest binds the review sources/tests/oracle while older manifests remain immutable historical snapshots
not_implied: HBM controller, SRAM macro, or physical memory realization
FP/exp pipeline or attention MAC realization
timing, throughput, deadlock freedom, area, energy, PPA, profiling, optimization, Gate-B, model/GPU, or A4-DSE evidence

disposition.next_required_action: plan RTL3 functional-source replacement for R03-1 through R03-4, then dynamic full-path coverage and aggregate provenance closure
